goal: Add --archive-threshold N to --archive-old-review-verdicts (skip below threshold) and an hourly review-verdict-auto-archive.yml workflow that archives at threshold 800 and fails if more than 900 remain; ceiling and archive-not-delete semantics unchanged
prohibited_actions: do not touch any migration or database object
do not raise the REVIEW_REF_ROW_LIMIT ceiling or weaken its refusal (#2152)
never delete a verdict; archive only by atomic move (#2987)
do not edit another session's handoff, worktree, branch, or claim
assumptions: the hourly job checks out with fetch-depth 1, so mergeTouchesMigrations cannot read merge commits and keeps every merged verdict as merge-commit-unreadable; a full-history checkout lets the #3806 rule act
stop_conditions: stop if a test fails for a reason unrelated to verdict archival or archive-mirror reads
stop if the change would need to touch a file outside allowed_paths
